title: Within-band heartbeat spectral entropy does not establish incremental cross-database CHF prediction
abstract: Adding within-HF-band RR spectral entropy changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by -0.00204 (source-and-target record bootstrap 95% [-0.01337, 0.00465]) beyond time-domain HRV and LF/HF powers. Incremental benefit was not established; target entropy permutation produced similar apparent improvements.
